scores.note: Bright, warm, and genuinely smiling without tipping into cheese. Natural, human phrasing on the staccato list — 'Calls. Answered.' lands conversational rather than robotic. Confident, modern, and premium; best fit for the brief.

Natural and human with excellent clarity and steady confidence. Warmth is genuine but the delivery sits a touch more neutral/efficient than bright and upbeat; slightly less smile in the voice than jessica.
Clear, confident, and human with good pacing. Tends toward a measured, grounded read rather than bright and upbeat; warmth is present but the smiling, energetic launch tone is less pronounced.

why: Jessica delivers the brief most precisely: warm and bright, upbeat, naturally human on the fragmented list copy, confident, and smiling throughout without ever sounding cheesy or salesy — the strongest match for a modern product launch narrator.
